finalText:
Migration is done. Twelve files still used the old call, 36 sites in all.

They now read `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the files migrated earlier.

Two things I left alone on purpose:
- `cache.query` is a different thing. The cache is not the database.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is vendored code. It gets replaced on upgrade.

`node verify.js` passes.

```
OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved
```
